title: Recast M2 extended-domain baseline
description: Strict non-runtime baseline for construction, food, combat, faction equipment and late-content leak prevention.

positionalConceptRefs.description: Positional typed-concept mapping for the adjacent free-text claim array. Semantic validation requires equal lengths and claim-to-concept kind compatibility; duplicates are allowed when several claims intentionally resolve to one abstract concept.

baseNativeEpochRange.description: Epoch interval in which this base level is native and may be newly generated. Semantic validation requires minimum <= maximum.

factionEpochCell.description: roles and role_loadout_bindings MUST have exact set parity; semantic validation also requires each object key to equal binding.role_id, all profile/ceiling epochs to equal this row, every archetype_ref to resolve within its tech bounds, and archetype_ref values to be distinct inside the cell.
